PZT_DIFFERENTIAL_DRIVING.meaning: Direct spatial Primary drive is small relative to Secondary; amplitude control changes Total by 4.30% of baseline DS, predominantly by modulation of the existing Secondary pattern. This diagnostic is not a validated shape threshold.

NUMERICAL_REPRODUCIBILITY.scope: Three same-device runs; maximum over three repeat-pair contrasts, not a confidence interval; frozen physics

PZT_TRANSLATION_CONTROL.meaning: Control-minus-unchanged centroid contrast; not net displacement from the mature state

PZT_SHAPE_CONTROL.uncertainty_scope: F2 historical near-field/mobility variations at the same initial state plus separate F3 1 pm/1 nm initial perturbations. No F3 physical model change. This is a conservative descriptive comparison, not a validated model-error bound.

NUMERICAL_QUALITY.meaning: Inherited finite/domain/clock/overlap/per-pass criteria only; does not validate local physical accuracy or dense-cluster morphology

PERFORMANCE.scope: One N200/5ms trajectory per execution mode at 10 us, same GPU/input specs; CUDA-event timings compiled/warmed and not additive; no new long/batch campaign
